name: Government level
description: The level a government sits at. It's worded to work in any country. Local names vary a lot - commune, municipio, kommun, ward, prefecture. Pick the closest term here, and put the local name in an identifier or alternateName instead of asking for a new one.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Supranational
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body above the national level, like the European Union.

hasDefinedTerm.name: National
hasDefinedTerm.description: The country itself. Matches the country codes in ISO 3166-1.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Regional
hasDefinedTerm.description: The first level below the country: a state, province, region, land, or canton. Matches ISO 3166-2.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Subregional
hasDefinedTerm.description: The second level below the country: a county, district, department, or prefecture.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Municipal
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local government: a city, municipality, commune, town, or borough.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Submunicipal
hasDefinedTerm.description: A part of a municipality: a ward, parish, neighbourhood council, or arrondissement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Special purpose
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body set up to do one job instead of govern an area, like a school district, transit authority, or water board.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Indigenous
hasDefinedTerm.description: An Indigenous, tribal, or First Nations government. It stands on its own here instead of nesting under another level, because its authority doesn't always come from a territory.
